documents: # Company FAQ

## General

### What are the office hours?
Standard office hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Employees on flexible working arrangements should agree their core hours with their manager.

### How many paid leave days do employees get per year?
Employees are entitled to 18 paid leave days every year. This includes both casual and privilege leave combined. New joiners accrue leave at 1.5 days per month from their start date.

### Can I work from home?
Yes. The company allows up to two work-from-home days per week. Mondays are mandatory office days for all employees. WFH arrangements should be agreed with your manager at the start of each month.

### How do I apply for leave?
Log in to the HR portal and submit a leave request at least 3 working days in advance. Your manager will approve or reject it within 2 working days. For emergencies, notify your manager directly on the same day.

### What happens to unused leave at year end?
You can carry forward a maximum of 5 unused leave days to the next year. Anything beyond 5 days lapses and cannot be encashed.

## Benefits

### Does the company provide health insurance?
Yes. All full-time employees and their immediate family (spouse and up to 2 children) are covered under the company's group health insurance plan up to INR 5,00,000 per year.

### Is there a gym allowance?
Yes. Employees receive INR 1,500 per month as a wellness allowance for gym memberships or fitness activities.

### Does the company offer pet insurance?
No. Pet insurance is not included in the employee benefits package. Only health, dental, vision, life insurance, and wellness allowances are provided.

## IT

### What should I do if I lose my company laptop?
Report the loss to IT Security (security@company.internal) immediately, within 1 hour of discovering the loss. IT will remotely wipe the device.

### Can I use personal devices for work?
No. Personal devices may not be used to access company systems unless specifically approved by the IT department.

## Payroll

### When is salary credited?
Salaries are credited on the last working day of each month directly to the bank account registered in the HR portal.

### How do I update my bank account details?
Log in to the HR portal, navigate to My Profile > Bank Details, and submit a change request. Changes take effect from the next payroll cycle.
# Employee Benefits

## Overview
The company provides a comprehensive benefits package to all full-time employees. Contract and part-time employees may be eligible for a subset of these benefits.

## Health Insurance
All employees and their immediate family members (spouse and up to 2 children) are covered under the company's group health insurance plan. The policy covers hospitalisation, day-care procedures, and pre- and post-hospitalisation expenses up to INR 5,00,000 per year.

## Dental Coverage
Basic dental care (cleaning, fillings, extractions) is covered up to INR 10,000 per year. Cosmetic dental procedures are not covered.

## Vision Care
Annual eye examinations and corrective lenses (glasses or contact lenses) are reimbursed up to INR 5,000 per year. Submit receipts to HR within 30 days of purchase.

## Gym and Wellness Allowance
Employees receive a monthly wellness allowance of INR 1,500, which can be used for gym memberships, yoga classes, or other fitness activities. Reimbursement requires a receipt.

## Life Insurance
The company provides a term life insurance cover of 3× the employee's annual CTC, at no cost to the employee.

## Provident Fund (PF)
The company contributes 12% of the employee's basic salary to the Provident Fund, matching the statutory employee contribution.

## Employee Stock Options (ESOPs)
Senior employees (Grade 4 and above) may be eligible for ESOPs based on performance. Details are communicated separately during the annual appraisal.

## Note
The company does not currently offer pet insurance as part of the employee benefits package.
# IT and Security Policy

## Overview
This policy sets out the rules for using company IT systems and handling company data. Compliance is mandatory for all employees, contractors, and interns.

## Acceptable Use
- Company devices (laptops, phones, tablets) are provided for business use. Limited personal use is permitted, provided it does not interfere with work or violate any other policy.
- Accessing, storing, or sharing illegal content on company devices is strictly prohibited.
- Employees must not install unlicensed software on company devices.

## Password Policy
- All account passwords must be at least 12 characters and include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters.
- Passwords must be changed every 90 days.
- Do not reuse any of the last 10 passwords.
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all company accounts including email, HR portal, and code repositories.

## Data Handling
- Confidential company data must not be stored on personal devices or personal cloud storage (e.g., personal Google Drive, Dropbox).
- Customer data is classified as "Restricted" and must only be accessed on a need-to-know basis.
- All data transfers outside the company network must use encrypted channels (HTTPS, SFTP, or VPN).

## Remote Access
- VPN must be used when accessing internal systems from outside the office network.
- Employees must lock their screen when stepping away from their workstation, especially in public spaces.

## Incident Reporting
Any suspected security incident, data breach, or lost/stolen device must be reported to IT Security (security@company.internal) within 1 hour of discovery.

## Software Updates
- Operating system and security patches must be applied within 48 hours of release.
- The IT team may push updates remotely; employees must not defer these updates.
# Leave Policy

## Overview
All full-time employees are entitled to paid leave as described in this policy. Leave must be applied for in advance through the HR portal and approved by the employee's direct manager.

## Annual Leave Entitlement
Every employee receives 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave is accrued at 1.5 days per month starting from the employee's joining date.

## Carry-Forward Rules
Up to 5 unused leave days may be carried forward to the next calendar year. Any unused leave beyond 5 days will lapse at year-end and cannot be encashed.

## Leave Application Process
1. Log in to the HR portal at hr.company.internal.
2. Submit a leave request at least 3 working days in advance for planned leave.
3. Your direct manager will approve or reject the request within 2 working days.
4. Emergency leave may be applied on the same day with a message to your manager.

## Types of Leave
- **Casual Leave**: 6 days per year, for personal errands or short breaks.
- **Sick Leave**: 10 days per year, requires a medical certificate for more than 2 consecutive days.
- **Maternity/Paternity Leave**: 26 weeks for primary caregiver, 5 days for secondary caregiver.
- **Bereavement Leave**: 3 days for immediate family members.

## Leave Balance
Employees can check their current leave balance any time in the HR portal or by asking the Employee Assistant.

## Restrictions
- Leave cannot be taken during a critical project deadline period without explicit manager approval.
- No more than 10 consecutive days of annual leave without HR Director approval.
# Business Travel Policy

## Overview
This policy governs all travel undertaken by employees on behalf of the company. All business travel must be pre-approved before bookings are made.

## Approval Process
1. Submit a travel request in the HR portal at least 5 working days before the intended departure date.
2. Include the purpose of travel, destination, estimated cost, and duration.
3. Approval is required from both the direct manager and the Finance team for trips exceeding INR 50,000.

## Booking
- All flights and hotels must be booked through the company's approved travel vendor (MakeMyTrip Business Account).
- Economy class is the default for flights under 6 hours. Business class may be approved for flights over 6 hours or for senior management.
- Hotel bookings should not exceed INR 5,000 per night in Tier-1 cities and INR 3,000 per night in other locations.

## Daily Allowance (Per Diem)
- Domestic travel: INR 1,500 per day for meals and local transport.
- International travel: USD 80 per day.
- Per diem is paid as a flat allowance and does not require receipts.

## Reimbursement
- Expenses beyond the per diem (e.g., client dinner) must be supported by original receipts and submitted within 7 working days of returning.
- Reimbursement requests are processed within 10 working days of submission.

## Personal Travel Extensions
Employees may extend a business trip for personal travel at their own cost, but the return date must be clearly marked as personal and not claimed for reimbursement.
# Work From Home Policy

## Overview
The company supports flexible working arrangements. Employees may work from home subject to the conditions described in this policy.

## WFH Entitlement
Employees are permitted to work from home for a maximum of 2 days per week. The specific days must be agreed upon with the employee's direct manager at the start of each month.

## WFH Restrictions
- **Mondays are mandatory office days.** All employees must be present in the office every Monday regardless of their WFH arrangement.
- Employees on probation (first 6 months) are not eligible for WFH and must be in the office 5 days a week.
- WFH is not permitted on days when the employee has scheduled in-person meetings, client visits, or all-hands sessions.

## Approval Process
1. Discuss your preferred WFH days with your manager before the start of each month.
2. Once agreed, update your calendar and notify your team.
3. Ad-hoc WFH requests (e.g., due to a delivery or home repair) require a Slack message to your manager by 8:00 AM that day.

## Equipment and Connectivity
- Employees are responsible for maintaining a stable internet connection while working from home.
- Company-issued laptops must be used for all work. Personal devices may not be used to access company systems unless approved by IT.
- VPN must be active whenever accessing internal company resources remotely.

## Accountability
Employees working from home are expected to maintain the same working hours and responsiveness as when in the office. Attendance at online stand-ups and video calls is mandatory during WFH days.
